name: bench-forge
description: File harness diagnostics as Forge tickets from a tenant Claude Code session — no GitHub account needed on the tenant side. Tickets land in Firestore, dedupe by content hash, and sync server-side to a GitHub issue in the Forge repo. All calls carry the user's Bench UID; tenant binding comes from auth.instanceId server-side.

tools.name: forge_submit_diagnostics
tools.description: Submit a diagnostics report as a Forge ticket. First submit returns 201 { ticketId, status: 'queued' }; an identical re-submit by the same user dedupes and returns 200 with the existing { ticketId, status, issueUrl? } — never a second GitHub issue. Rate limit: 10 tickets per user per 24h.

body_schema.subject: string (short, scannable summary — becomes the GitHub issue title)
body_schema.reporterContext: object (optional; machine + CLI/gateway versions + doctor checks, e.g. { machine, benchCliVersion, gatewayVersion, doctorChecks })

response_schema.status: 'queued' on create (201); existing ticket status on duplicate (200)
response_schema.issueUrl: string (optional; present on duplicates once the GitHub sync has landed)

tools.name: forge_ticket_status
tools.description: Poll a submitted ticket's GitHub sync status. Owner-only — callers can only read tickets they filed. syncStatus moves pending → synced (issueNumber + issueUrl set) or pending → failed (failureReason set).
